I traced the issue and recorded the diagnosis in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). I did not edit project source or tests because this pass was limited to fault localization.

- [useElements.ts](/app/applications/mail/src/app/hooks/mailbox/useElements.ts:99) calls the loading selector without the current page and params. Its load effect also has no guard for backend operations still in progress.
- [elementsActions.ts](/app/applications/mail/src/app/logic/elements/elementsActions.ts:23) accepts every resolved query result. On failure it dispatches `retry` after two seconds, but [elementsSlice.ts](/app/applications/mail/src/app/logic/elements/elementsSlice.ts:72) has no retry case; a rejected load can leave `pendingRequest` true.
- [elementQuery.ts](/app/applications/mail/src/app/logic/elements/helpers/elementQuery.ts:41) drops the API’s `Stale` flag, so [loadFulfilled](/app/applications/mail/src/app/logic/elements/elementsReducers.ts:51) can commit stale elements and totals.

The fix needs to track overlapping backend operations, defer reloads until the count reaches zero, retry failures after two seconds, and retry `Stale === 1` responses after one second without committing them. I found no existing lifecycle dispatches for backend item operations; their integration points remain the main uncertainty.

Updated the mailbox list to wait for tracked backend item operations before reloading. Failed fetches now retry after two seconds; responses marked stale are discarded and retried after one second. The loading selector uses the current page and query parameters.

Validation passed: the mail TypeScript check, all 12 mailbox element tests, and `git diff --check`.

VERDICT: FIX

The applied patch has two correctness issues:

- [useApplyLabels.tsx](/app/applications/mail/src/app/hooks/useApplyLabels.tsx:208): `Promise.all` rejects when the first label request fails, so `backendActionFinished` can run while other label requests are still in flight. Wait for every request to settle before decrementing the counter.
- [elementsReducers.ts](/app/applications/mail/src/app/logic/elements/elementsReducers.ts:67): a list fetch started before a backend action can still commit its result during that action. Discard or invalidate that result and reload after the action finishes.

Test command: `yarn workspace proton-mail test --runTestsByPath src/app/containers/mailbox/tests/Mailbox.elements.test.tsx src/app/helpers/elements.test.ts --watch=false` — **passed**, 2 suites and 31 tests. These tests do not cover the identified races. TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM: none.

Fixed both reviewed races. Label changes now wait for every request to settle before ending the backend action. A list fetch that overlaps an action is discarded, then retried after the action; actions without an overlapping fetch no longer trigger an extra reload that could overwrite optimistic UI state.

The reviewer’s exact test command passed: **31 tests**. Two new race regression tests also passed. No remaining failures or test environment problems.
